title: A Causal Bootstrap for Diverse Image Generation under Unobserved Confounding
abstract: arXiv:2606.21806v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep generative models reproduce the observational distribution underlying the training data, which, in turn, inherit any spurious associations it contains. A common source is an unobserved confounder that simultaneously affects both a treatment attribute the user wants to control/edit (e.g., age, sex) and an observed outcome (e.g., an image) expected to vary in response. Existing causal inference methods resolve the resulting ambiguity by imposing structural assumptions strong enough to single out one interventional distribution. However, in practical domains like image generation, such assumptions are rarely warranted, and the interventional distribution is generally non-identifiable: distinct causal models can agree on the observed data yet imply different causal predictions. translated_title: 未观测混杂下多样性图像生成的因果自举方法
translated_abstract: 深度生成模型再现的是训练数据背后的观测分布，而该分布会继承其中所包含的一切虚假关联。一个常见的来源是未观测的混杂因子，它同时影响用户想要控制或编辑的处理属性（如年龄、性别）以及预期会随之变化的观测结果（如图像）。现有的因果推断方法通过施加足够强的结构假设来解决由此产生的歧义，从而能够唯一确定一个干预分布。然而，在图像生成等实际领域中，此类假设很少能够成立，且干预分布通常是不可识别的：不同的因果模型可以在观测数据上完全一致，却会得出不同的因果预测。本文提出了CauVaDE（因果变分深度嵌入），这是一类新颖的因果生成模型族，其中未观测的混杂因子坍缩为
tldr: 本文提出了一类名为CauVaDE的因果生成模型族，能够在不依赖强结构假设的情况下处理未观测混杂因子，解决了图像生成中干预分布不可识别的问题，实现多样性的因果图像生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CauVaDE, a novel family of causal generative models that addresses non-identifiability of interventional distributions under unobserved confounding, enabling diverse causal image generation without relying on strong structural assumptions.
